excerpts: The Rood Avenue Parking Garage provides a total of 434 parking spaces, with 126 spaces available for short-term and daily public parking, including accessible (handicapped) spaces and motorcycle parking, while the remaining spaces are designated for long-term leased parking.
Permit holders may only park in designated ten-hour parking metered spaces or lots.
